description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {C}{C}.
Ghired dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ghired enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Rhino creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rhino, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
